speaker: john_heminges
text: Richard the Third is off. You had no part in it. I am not going to invent one after the fact.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had no part. I was in the house. That is the whole of my share of the afternoon.

speaker: margery_pell
text: And the yard did not listen. I stood the stair. I know a house that is not hearing a play.

speaker: hired_men
text: The news came in while you were on the boards, such as the boards were. I have it by report. I did not see it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then say it as report. I was not in Cheapside. I am not going to be put there.

speaker: hired_men
text: Eighteen hundred, by report. They pulled two pillories down. They went against the Counter again.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Two pillories. I will not add a third to make it round. I was on this stair.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eighteen hundred is a report's number. I will not enter it as a count of mine. I was here.

speaker: hired_men
text: And the timber. They carried it toward Bishopsgate. That is as much as I was told, and I am not walking down to see the end of it for you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then nobody in this room saw it. A play nobody listened to, and a report from a place I was not in.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I can say the yard was thin of ears. I cannot say what a crowd did in Cheapside. Do not ask me to.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No part for you on the plot. No figure for a house that did not listen. I am writing both of those, and not a third thing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Write them. I am going home by the ordinary road. If there is timber at the end of it, I will see timber, and not a story.

speaker: hired_men
text: By report, the timber went to the Mayor's gate. I will not swear to a gate I have not stood at.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then do not swear. I am locking my stair on a play nobody heard.

speaker: john_heminges
text: God give you the road down. Come in if the road is a road, and not a crowd.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not a crowd. I was not in theirs. Good night, John.
